10.2.10.14 DemTextTableMapping
SWS Item
[ECUC_Dem_00849]
Container Name
DemTextTableMapping
Parent Container
DemAlternativeDataType
Description
The purpose of the DemDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined
in the context of the Dem to a texttable value defined in the context of a CompuMethod
referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in a Sender
ReceiverInterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a
TexttableMapping (which can only be applied if a dataElement already exists).
In other words, the DemDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the
TexttableMapping in a situation where the TexttableMapping cannot be applied since
the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dem ServiceComponent
does not yet exist.
Configuration Parameters
SWS Item
[ECUC_Dem_00851]
Parameter Name
DemDiagnosisRepresentationDataValue
Parent Container
DemTextTableMapping
Description
The data value in the diagnosis representation.
